name: RI Riddle Room: Escape Game
address: 1150 Bald Hill Road, Warwick, RI 02886 (behind the Sonic)

booking.howItWorks: Book a private escape game online at least 30 minutes ahead. For the birthday party room, corporate packages, Monster in the Museum premium pricing or groups over 10, call (401) 398-8177 or email.

packages.name: Private Escape Game / Basic Party Package
packages.description: Choose Rocky Point Park, Vanishing at The Velmont, Forest of Fortune or Imaginasium of Intrigue. $85 private booking fee includes the first 2 tickets; $29 per person for up to 8 additional players. 3-10 participants recommended for parties.
includes: Gamemaster intro to rules and story

packages.name: Monster in the Museum (premium game)
packages.description: Premium game with live actors, dynamic lighting and theatrics. Special dynamic pricing based on group size. Recommended for ages 10 and over.

packages.name: Corporate Basic Package
packages.description: Per-person pricing, private room fee waived. $35/person Monday-Friday, $40/person Saturday-Sunday. Up to 10 per room, 4 rooms (40 total). War room free for one hour with 10+ tickets; entire facility private with 25+ participants.
includes: War room free for 1 hour with 10+ tickets

packages.name: Corporate Double-Header (add-on game)
packages.description: Add a second escape room to the corporate package. $25/person add-on Monday-Friday, $30/person Saturday-Sunday. Up to 40 participants per hour.

packages.name: Premium Team Building - Monster in the Museum
packages.description: Premium team building packages for Monster in the Museum with live actors and expansive sets. Call or email for information.

addOns.name: Additional player
addOns.description: Each player beyond the 2 included tickets, up to 8 additional players.

addOns.name: Birthday party room (1 hour)
addOns.description: One hour in the party room after the escape game; flat fee due at booking. Hosts may arrive an hour early to set up. Fridge/freezer, tables and seating. No confetti.

faq.a: Our starting price is $85, which includes the private booking fee & your first 2 tickets. Each additional ticket is $29 per person. Monster in the Museum is a premium game with special pricing that is dynamic based on group size.

We do provide a discount for nonprofits, students, and active military, give us a call to receive your discount. Corporate: 15% discount for Schools and Non-Profits; 10% discount for prepayment in full 14 days or more in advance.
Give us a call to make a minimum down payment. We can handle the rest the day of your booking.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance?
faq.a: Yes, we require bookings to be made 30 minutes in advance. Call (401) 398-8177 for walk in availability.

faq.q: How many participants can I bring?
faq.a: Our games are designed for groups of 2-10. If you have more than 10 participants, please send us an email. We can accommodate up to 28 people in our facility for parties.

faq.q: Which game is best for big groups?
faq.a: We recommend The Forest of Fortune for bigger groups as it is our most spacious game.

faq.q: Are we actually locked in a room?
faq.a: No. The exit door is always unlocked in case of claustrophobia or an emergency.
Our games are designed to be family friendly. Our intention is never to scare you. Monster in the Museum is recommended for 10 years old and over.

faq.q: Will other people play with us?
faq.a: No, all of our games are private. Once you've booked a room, it's just you and your group.
Yes, for the most part. Some of our games contain uneven surfaces or small steps up. Contact us for more information.
We have a private parking lot with plenty of spaces.
All team members will need to fill out a waiver; the link is in your confirmation email.
Yes. If you can't make your game, please give us a call or email to reschedule.

faq.q: Can we bring food and cake?
faq.a: We don't provide any food or beverages. We have a refrigerator/freezer for storage, please bring your own food & drinks. Outside catering is welcomed.

faq.q: Can we decorate the party room?
faq.a: You may decorate the party room any way you like and arrive an hour early to set up. No confetti or obtrusive decorations, extreme cleaning fee will apply.
